_about: Hand-marked on the 900 px fixtures, 26 Nov 2026, for the side-profile guide oval: the oval must enclose every point. forehead = where the hairline meets the front of the face; brow = brow ridge front; nose = nose tip; lips = front of the lips; chin_front = front of the chin; chin_bottom = underside of the chin; ear = middle of the ear, where it shows (hidden by hair on close_06 and close_01).
